- Mammogram in network is $0 per provider per day on page 57, so items 1 and 17 are true.
- The out-of-network diagnostic radiology row is on page 58 and reads 50% coinsurance. It continues the diagnostic radiology row from page 57, which lists CT, MRI, PET and mammography. That makes the out-of-network facts for PET (2), mammogram (9), MRI (16) and CT (18) true. For mammogram, the 50% applies to the whole diagnostic radiology row, so it is plausible. The quote "What you pay Out-of-network: 50% coinsurance" is slightly merged, but the content is supported.
- "All other complex imaging" at $300 is the in-network cost for CT, MRI and PET, since the row names them as the covered tests. That covers items 6, 10, 11, 13, 14 and 19 as true.
- Item 4 uses `imaging.diagnostic.advanced.other` for "all other complex imaging". The $300 is the document's wording, but the "other" benefit is meant for advanced imaging the document does not name. Here CT, MRI and PET are named in the service description, and the $300 applies to them, with mammography excluded. I treat this as doubtful and mark it false.
- Item 12 is `imaging.diagnostic` at $300. Diagnostic radiology includes mammography at $0, so a single $300 is wrong for the whole category. False.
- Item 15 is `imaging.diagnostic.advanced` at $300, covering CT, MRI and PET together. That is correct, so true. The quote is truncated but sufficient.
